morphology.pattern_note: putik 是不可再按现代马来语词缀拆分的词根。词尾 k 通常读为声门塞音 [ʔ]；berputik 保留词根，memutikkan 中 meN- 遇词首 p 时变为 mem-，p 脱落。

word_family.gloss: 开始结出幼果；开始萌生
促使萌生；促成初步成果

senses.zh_definition: 刚形成、仍然细小稚嫩的果实；幼果。
senses.en_definition: A newly formed fruit that is still very small and immature; a fruitlet.
senses.ms_definition: Buah yang baru jadi, masih muda dan kecil.
senses.nuances: 指刚结果时的幼小果实，不能笼统等同于所有未成熟水果，也不宜在本义中直接译成一般花苞。berputik 可引申为感情或事业开始萌生，但不必因此另立 putik 的动词义。参见 [DBP：putik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=putik)。

dual_scenarios.context: 农业新闻 / 果园工作汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pegawai pertanian sedang menyiasat punca keguguran putik durian di kebun tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 农业官员正在调查该果园榴梿幼果脱落的原因。
dual_scenarios.en: Agricultural officers are investigating why durian fruitlets are dropping in that orchard.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 家人讨论院子里的果树
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Pokok mangga kat belakang dah ada putik!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Pokok mangga di belakang rumah sudah mempunyai putik!
dual_scenarios.zh: 屋后那棵芒果树已经结小果了！
dual_scenarios.en: The mango tree out back has little fruit on it already!
spoken_features: belakang 依共同语境省略 rumah
口语有时使用 ada 代替较正式的 mempunyai

messages.speaker: Aina (姐姐)
messages.ms_spoken: Tengok ni, pokok mangga kita dah ada putik!
messages.ms_standard: Lihatlah ini, pokok mangga kita sudah mempunyai putik!
messages.zh: 快看，我们的芒果树已经结小果了！
messages.en: Look, our mango tree has tiny fruit on it already!

messages.speaker: Hakim (弟弟)
messages.ms_spoken: Wah, banyaknya! Jangan petik dulu, kecil lagi tu.
messages.ms_standard: Wah, banyaknya! Jangan petik dahulu kerana putik itu masih kecil.
messages.zh: 哇，这么多！先别摘，还小着呢。
messages.en: Wow, there are loads! Don't pick them yet—they're still tiny.

etymology.historical_story: Putik belongs to the vocabulary of observing fruit trees: it names fruit at its earliest, smallest stage. Malay carries this agricultural image into berputik, which can describe love or an endeavour beginning to develop. The image links visible growth with emerging possibility. This is a documented semantic connection, rather than a claim about the word’s deeper ancestry. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=putik).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pu-tiʔ 想成两拍“小—果”：果实刚冒出来，还小得很。再记 berputik＝开始结小果，也可表示开始萌生。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 本义是中性农业词，日常聊天和正式报道都可使用。谈论别人的感情时，cinta mula berputik 带有浪漫、略文学的语气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合园艺、果园和农作物话题。参观别人果园时，不应未经允许采摘幼果；谈及私人恋情，也应避免把推测当作事实。
